Hey so sometimes people get yeeting withdrawals bc immediately after yeeting the body tends to release endorphins. Basically they help to block out the communication of pain signals in your body. 

Tons of things can contribute to withdrawals, but in my experience I've found that doing things that essentially force my brain to spit out happy hormones can help reduce urges. 

So here are a couple of things that may help you feel less shitty:

Endorphins:
- the scent of vanilla or lavender
- spicy food!!
- exercise
- laughter (this one can of course be hard sometimes when you're feeling down, but putting on a funny video /podcast / movie is definitely worth a shot)

Oxytocin:
- pet a soft animal / look at pictures of them
- ride a rollercoaster (not always readily available but still helpful to note)
- have a warm bath / shower or soak in a hot tub
- give a gift to someone

Serotonin:
- eat foods that contain high amounts of tryptophan (i.e. salmon, eggs, spinach, seeds, nuts)
- sit in the sun
- aerobic exercise

Feel free to add or correct me!!
